reportChecks.name: Today/week/month sales
reportChecks.formula: Gross = Σ(quantity × unit price); net = gross − header discount. Demo tax is zero.

reportChecks.name: Tender collections
reportChecks.formula: Sum of source amounts grouped by tender; source link opens a contributing record.

reportChecks.name: Returns
reportChecks.formula: Completed return amounts; draft returns are excluded.

reportChecks.name: Estimated gross profit/margin
reportChecks.formula: Estimated gross profit = net sales − line cost snapshots; excludes operating expenses.

reportChecks.name: Activity
reportChecks.formula: Local audit events only; this is not a server security or fiscal sequence audit.

reportChecks.name: Issues and branch comparison
reportChecks.formula: Sum of source amounts grouped by branch_id; source link opens a contributing record.

reportChecks.name: Gross/net
reportChecks.formula: Gross = Σ(quantity × unit price); net = gross − header discount. Demo tax is zero.

reportChecks.name: Discounts
reportChecks.formula: Header discount on completed sales.

reportChecks.name: Tax breakdown
reportChecks.formula: Tax = quantity × unit price × line tax rate / 100; demo exclusive-tax calculation.

reportChecks.name: By SKU
reportChecks.formula: Units and revenue from completed sales line items; category uses current product classification.

reportChecks.name: Category
reportChecks.formula: Units and revenue from completed sales line items; category uses current product classification.

reportChecks.name: Cashier
reportChecks.formula: Sum of source amounts grouped by cashier; source link opens a contributing record.

reportChecks.name: Branch
reportChecks.formula: Sum of source amounts grouped by branch_id; source link opens a contributing record.

reportChecks.name: Day
reportChecks.formula: Sum of source amounts grouped by business_date; source link opens a contributing record.

reportChecks.name: Price tier
reportChecks.formula: Sum of source amounts grouped by price_tier; source link opens a contributing record.

reportChecks.name: Sales channel
reportChecks.formula: Sum of source amounts grouped by channel; source link opens a contributing record.

reportChecks.name: Returns
reportChecks.formula: Completed return amounts; draft returns are excluded.

reportChecks.name: Opening/closing
reportChecks.formula: Current product snapshot; opening stock is the seeded local baseline.

reportChecks.name: Available/reserved/in-transit/damaged
reportChecks.formula: Merchant-owned = physical − remaining customer custody; demo reservations are zero.

reportChecks.name: Stock card
reportChecks.formula: Source records filtered by branch and business date; values are not fabricated.

reportChecks.name: Ageing
reportChecks.formula: Days since last completed sale in the selected dataset. Inventory lot age is not derived from this metric.

reportChecks.name: Dead stock
reportChecks.formula: Days since last completed sale in the selected dataset. Inventory lot age is not derived from this metric.

reportChecks.name: Below reorder
reportChecks.formula: Current product snapshot; opening stock is the seeded local baseline.

reportChecks.name: Count variances
reportChecks.formula: Variance = counted quantity − expected quantity.

reportChecks.name: Multi-warehouse valuation
reportChecks.formula: Current local quantity × product cost; production weighted-average valuation is not implemented.

reportChecks.name: PO lead time
reportChecks.formula: Received quantities include completed goods receipts only. Lead-time and supplier score calculations require production event timestamps.

reportChecks.name: Partial receipts
reportChecks.formula: Received quantities include completed goods receipts only. Lead-time and supplier score calculations require production event timestamps.

reportChecks.name: Supplier costs and discrepancies
reportChecks.formula: Received quantities include completed goods receipts only. Lead-time and supplier score calculations require production event timestamps.

reportChecks.name: Supplier performance
reportChecks.formula: Received quantities include completed goods receipts only. Lead-time and supplier score calculations require production event timestamps.

reportChecks.name: AR ageing invoice-by-invoice
reportChecks.formula: Open balance = completed sale net total − completed allocated payments; deposits are not silently treated as payments.

reportChecks.name: Collections
reportChecks.formula: Sum of source amounts grouped by tender; source link opens a contributing record.

reportChecks.name: Deposit liability
reportChecks.formula: Remaining liability = deposit − allocated amount.

reportChecks.name: Credit exposure and limit exceptions
reportChecks.formula: Open balance = completed sale net total − completed allocated payments; deposits are not silently treated as payments.

reportChecks.name: AP ageing
reportChecks.formula: Source records filtered by branch and business date; values are not fabricated.

reportChecks.name: Advances
reportChecks.formula: Unallocated supplier advance = amount − allocated amount.

reportChecks.name: Payment history and supplier credit notes
reportChecks.formula: Source records filtered by branch and business date; values are not fabricated.

reportChecks.name: Expected/counted cash
reportChecks.formula: Cash variance = counted − expected. Local expected balance is an editable draft field.

reportChecks.name: Shift variance
reportChecks.formula: Cash variance = counted − expected. Local expected balance is an editable draft field.

reportChecks.name: Expenses by category
reportChecks.formula: Sum of source amounts grouped by category; source link opens a contributing record.

reportChecks.name: Refunds
reportChecks.formula: Completed return amounts; draft returns are excluded.

reportChecks.name: Provider settlement
reportChecks.formula: Difference = recorded net − (gross − fees).

reportChecks.name: Outstanding unknown payment status
reportChecks.formula: Non-finalized payment records; no provider status is inferred.

reportChecks.name: Cart conversion
reportChecks.formula: Order completion ratio only. True cart conversion requires visitor/cart analytics not present in this local demo.

reportChecks.name: Order fulfillment
reportChecks.formula: Source records filtered by branch and business date; values are not fabricated.

reportChecks.name: Delivery performance
reportChecks.formula: Source records filtered by branch and business date; values are not fabricated.

reportChecks.name: Refund rate
reportChecks.formula: Count of completed return records divided by completed sales; not a monetary refund-rate metric.

reportChecks.name: Checkout errors
reportChecks.formula: Units and revenue from completed sales line items; category uses current product classification.

reportChecks.name: Storefront SKU performance
reportChecks.formula: Units and revenue from completed sales line items; category uses current product classification.

reportChecks.name: Device sync lag
reportChecks.formula: Source records filtered by branch and business date; values are not fabricated.

reportChecks.name: Rejected operations
reportChecks.formula: Source records filtered by branch and business date; values are not fabricated.

reportChecks.name: Stock quota depletion

reportChecks.formula: Remaining customer custody = owned − collected; source records retain pickup dates.

reportChecks.name: Operational trial balance

reportChecks.name: Bank/provider clearing aging
reportChecks.formula: Unmatched = bank amount − matched amount.

reportChecks.name: Intercompany unmatched balances
reportChecks.formula: Source records filtered by branch and business date; values are not fabricated.

reportChecks.name: Project exposure
reportChecks.formula: Source records filtered by branch and business date; values are not fabricated.

reportChecks.name: Cutting yield/waste
reportChecks.formula: Remainder = parent length − (output length + kerf) × output count; all values must share a unit.

reportChecks.name: Recall reach
reportChecks.formula: Source records filtered by branch and business date; values are not fabricated.

reportChecks.name: Recovery reconciliation
reportChecks.formula: Difference = recovered records − expected records.
